title: King of Zugzwang
reviewNotes: Three branches, 34 exact positions from the complete seven-piece root (black Rg2). Qa3+ ...Ra2 Rd2 prepares ...b2+ Qxb2+ ...Rxb2 Rxb2. The selected full rook conversion avoids stalemate, answers ...a1=N+ with Kc3, and ends in actual Rh1 mate. Immediate queen acceptance permits Rb2 ...Ra2 Rb1 mate. Qf6+ ...b2+ Qxb2+ ...Rxb2 is exactly drawn. Selected king replies and knight-underpromotion route are not an exhaustive defense tree.
